offering_description.value: Kadant designs and manufactures equipment for fiber and wood processing, industrial fluid control, and bulk material handling. It sells complete systems and replacement parts to mills, factories, recyclers, and equipment builders, and provides field service.

primary_products.value: fiber stock preparation and recycling systems; wood processing machinery; rotary joints and steam systems; doctor blades and roll-cleaning systems; bulk conveyors and vibratory equipment

primary_services.value: equipment installation and commissioning; field maintenance and repair; equipment rebuilding and upgrades

customer_segment.value: B2B: Pulp and paper mills, wood panel producers, recyclers, industrial plants, and equipment manufacturers

end_markets.value: pulp, paper and packaging; engineered wood products; recycling and waste processing; mining and aggregates; food processing

revenue_model.value: product sales: New machinery, system components, replacement parts, and consumables; project or contract: Engineered processing and conveying systems configured for individual facilities; service fees: On-site installation, maintenance, repair, and equipment rebuilds
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds processing, fluid control, and conveying equipment from metals and purchased components for industrial operators; component supplier: Supplies rotary joints, blades, and other machine components to equipment builders and industrial operators; service provider: Installs, maintains, and rebuilds machinery for mills and other industrial plants
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; component supplier; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia, and South America

specialization.value: related lines: Fiber and wood processing, industrial flow control, and bulk material handling equipment

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Technical sales teams serving mills and industrial plants; distributors / dealers: Independent industrial equipment and replacement-parts distributors; agents / brokers: Independent manufacturers’ representatives in selected markets
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Manufacturing and machinery subject to workplace safety, machine guarding, and environmental rules, including OSHA requirements in the United States

notes: The current relative size of the industrial processing and flow control lines is uncertain.
